# Novifaro

> Novifaro combines Novi (new) and Faro (lighthouse), representing New Light. We believe every great idea deserves to be seen. Through creativity, technology, and innovation, we bring new light to businesses, brands, and digital experiences.

Novifaro is a Toronto, Ontario, Canada studio for brand strategy, digital products, websites, and purposeful AI.

## Blog articles

- [What Is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?](https://novifaro.ca/blog/what-is-generative-engine-optimization-geo.html): GEO explained: how to make your business visible in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Claude, with a practical 8-step checklist.
- [Small Business SEO Checklist for Toronto and Canada](https://novifaro.ca/blog/small-business-seo-checklist-toronto.html): A practical SEO checklist for small businesses in Toronto and across Canada: technical basics, service pages, local SEO, Google Business Profile, and monthly tracking.
- [Website Design That Converts: 10 Must-Have Elements](https://novifaro.ca/blog/website-design-that-converts.html): What makes a website convert visitors into customers: clear messaging, fast load times, strong calls to action, trust signals, simple forms, and ongoing testing.
- [AI Automation for Small Business: 7 Use Cases](https://novifaro.ca/blog/ai-automation-for-small-business.html): Seven practical ways small businesses use AI systems and automation to save time, answer customers faster, and grow, plus a safe step-by-step plan to get started.
- [Digital Marketing Strategy: A 90-Day Plan](https://novifaro.ca/blog/digital-marketing-strategy-90-day-plan.html): A simple 90-day digital marketing plan for small businesses: set goals, fix your foundation, launch SEO, content, email and ads, then measure and scale what works.
- [How to Measure Digital Marketing ROI](https://novifaro.ca/blog/measure-digital-marketing-roi.html): Learn how to calculate digital marketing ROI, which KPIs to track (CAC, conversion rate, ROAS, LTV), and how to set up GA4, UTM tracking, and a simple monthly report.
- [Local SEO: Get More Customers from Google Maps](https://novifaro.ca/blog/local-seo-google-maps-more-customers.html): How local SEO brings more customers to your business: optimize your Google Business Profile, earn reviews, build local pages, and win "near me" searches in Toronto and across Canada.
- [How an AI Sales Assistant Turns Visitors into Customers](https://novifaro.ca/blog/ai-sales-assistant-website-visitors-to-customers.html): How a custom AI assistant on your website answers questions, qualifies leads, and books appointments 24/7 so more of your visitors become customers.
- [Google Ads and Retargeting: Get Customers Faster](https://novifaro.ca/blog/paid-ads-retargeting-get-customers-faster.html): How paid advertising and retargeting bring customers quickly: when to use Google Ads vs Meta ads, how to set up conversion tracking, and how paid and SEO work together.
